title: D-branes and orientifolds on quasicrystalline orbifold backgrounds
summary: We construct and analyse orientifold descendants of a six-dimensional type IIB $\mathbb Z_{12}$ quasicrystalline orbifold. The parent background is defined by a Narain-lattice automorphism that is not crystallographic on the geometric torus. We determine the closed-string spectrum and twisted-sector orbit structure, construct a compatible unoriented projection, and compute the Klein bottle, annulus and Möbius strip amplitudes.
